purpose: Paired-protocol experiment for the Neural Networks upgrade: matched-recipe RetinaNet arms plus reuse of the existing hash-bound paired matrices.

blocks.evidence: existing coco_uniform_p0_v1 + codec_control_p0_v1 predictions evaluated on the frozen subset
existing for fp32/legacy; new builds+runs for matched arms
existing for fp32/legacy; new builds+runs for matched arms

excluded.rtdetr_l: INT8 collapses ~1 AP under the historical recipe; excluded from primary pending its own recipe decomposition (scope bound).

estimands.primary_contrast: per-block paired clean/corrupted AP per arm; retention per arm; FP8-INT8 gaps G0, Gc and interaction DeltaE = Gc - G0
estimands.recipe_contrast: retinanet int8-legacy vs int8-matched512 vs int8-selective512 under identical conditions
estimands.uncertainty: paired image-bootstrap percentile intervals, 2000 draws; block means within draws; grouped by dataset
estimands.pooling: YOLO11 n/m/x macro within family per dataset; RetinaNet reported per dataset, never pooled with YOLO

controls: absolute corrupted AP reported alongside every normalized contrast
clean cost of selective precision reported per dataset
single build + single calibration realization per arm; no seed/build-population inference
no latency claims (shared GPU; latency evidence inadmissible)
all subset/reuse decisions frozen before inspecting new AP values
kill_criteria: if corrected recipes erase the effect of interest, report the recipe-confound study rather than a method claim
